基乌的魔力 (Chinese (Simplified)) 基乌能看到其他人看不到而令人兴奋的东西-飞行火箭和在黑板上游泳的鱼。奶奶带着基乌去看眼科医生了解她的魔力。 This is a Level 1 book for children who are eager to begin reading. Pratham Books goes digital to weave a whole new chapter in the realm of multilingual children's stories. Knitting together children, authors, illustrators and publishers. Folding in teachers, and translators. To create a rich fabric of openly licensed multilingual stories for the children of India and the world. Our unique online platform, StoryWeaver, is a playground where children, parents, teachers and librarians can get creative. Come, start weaving today, and help us get a book in every child's hand!

pages.originalText: 基乌上学迟到了。 但她找不到她的红色瓶子。
pages.text:
基乌上学快迟到了。
可是她找不到自己的红色水瓶。

image.attributionText: Page 2: Girl standing in front of the mirror , by Shrujana Shridhar © Pratham Books, 2017. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 那是她的瓶子吗？ 还是一个火箭？
pages.text:
那是她的瓶子吗？
还是一个火箭？

image.attributionText: Page 3: Spaceship in space with stars , by Shrujana Shridhar © Pratham Books, 2017. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 基乌看着黑板，而想着,“那些是在海里游的鱼吗？”
pages.text:
基乌看着黑板，心想：
“那些是在海里游的鱼吗？”

image.attributionText: Page 4: Fish swimming out of alphabets , by Shrujana Shridhar © Pratham Books, 2017. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 基乌盯着鞋上的一滴绿色斑点，想着,“这很粘，看起来像果冻。 难道是一只青蛙吗? ”
pages.text:
基乌盯着鞋上的一个绿色斑点，心想：
“黏黏的，看起来像果冻。难道是一只青蛙吗？”

image.attributionText: Page 5: Girl pointing at a frog , by Shrujana Shridhar © Pratham Books, 2017. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 基乌跑着回家跟奶奶说,“我有神奇的魔力！ 我能看到别人看不到的东西 。 ”
pages.text:
基乌跑回家，对奶奶说：
“我有神奇的魔力！ 我能看到别人看不到的东西。”

image.attributionText: Page 6: Girl running in a street , by Shrujana Shridhar © Pratham Books, 2017. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 奶奶点点头而问，“那么我们是不是应该去眼科医生那，告诉她你的魔力？”
pages.text: 奶奶点点头，问：“那么，我们是不是该去眼科医生那里，告诉她你的魔力？”

image.attributionText: Page 7: Girl talking to her grandmother , by Shrujana Shridhar © Pratham Books, 2017. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.
Page 8: Girl pointing at ants at the optician , by Shrujana Shridhar © Pratham Books, 2017. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.imageAlt: 《基乌的魔力》原书第8页的故事插图

pages.originalText:
尼基塔医生拿了一张图表给基乌看。

“那些蚂蚁正在图上行进吗? ”

基乌问道。
pages.text:
尼基塔医生拿了一张图表给基乌看。
“那些蚂蚁正在图上走吗？”基乌问道。

image.attributionText: Page 9: Ants crawling , by Shrujana Shridhar © Pratham Books, 2017. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 尼基塔医生帮基乌试戴眼镜。 最大的蚂蚁变成了E.
pages.text:
尼基塔医生帮基乌试戴眼镜。
最大的蚂蚁变成了E。

image.attributionText: Page 10: Girl wearing glasses, ants on alphabet chart , by Shrujana Shridhar © Pratham Books, 2017. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: “难道我失去我的魔法了吗，医生?”基乌问道。 “闭上眼睛做梦。 你的魔法会回来的, ” 尼基塔医生说。
pages.text:
“难道我失去魔法了吗，医生？”基乌问道。
“闭上眼睛做梦吧，你的魔法会回来的。”
尼基塔医生说。

image.attributionText: Page 11: Octopus, frog, fish, spaceship floating in water and space , by Shrujana Shridhar © Pratham Books, 2017. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: “基乌，你想要什么颜色的眼镜？”奶奶问道。 “给我绿色的吧,”基乌笑着说。
pages.text:
“基乌，你想要什么颜色的眼镜？”奶奶问道。
“给我绿色的吧！”基乌笑着说。

image.attributionText: Page 12: Girl jumping in excitement, grandmother smiling , by Shrujana Shridhar © Pratham Books, 2017. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 眼镜的情况 基乌没有戴眼镜而看不太清楚。 你能帮她吗？
pages.text:
戴上眼镜看看吧
基乌没有戴眼镜，看不太清楚。
你能帮她吗？
